Plot a region property map on a pixel grid

Source: R/plot_region_property_raster.R
plot_region_property_raster.Rd

Plot a region property map on a pixel grid

Usage

plot_region_property_raster(
  cluster_map,
  values,
  palette = "magma",
  value_label = "Value",
  na_color = "white",
  show_legend = TRUE
)

Arguments

cluster_map

matrix of region identifiers.

values

named numeric vector of region values.

palette

viridis option name or palette vector.

value_label

legend title.

na_color

fill color for missing values.

show_legend

logical; whether to display the legend.

Value

A ggplot2 object.
